entities.name: First Treaty of San Ildefonso
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The First Treaty of San Ildefonso was signed on 1 October 1777 between Spain and Portugal. It settled long-running territorial disputes between the two kingdoms' possessions in South America, primarily in the Río de la Plata region.
